description: Group precedence for a member with its own schedule. The member (Once per 60 Minutes, own window 11:00-13:00) belongs to a group scheduled 12:00-13:00. While the group window is active the member is suppressed from the top-level rotation and plays only via the group; before the group window it plays standalone (null playlist chain). The member's windowed type places it in a strictly higher-priority bucket than the group, so a suppression regression fails deterministically instead of depending on the weighted shuffle.
